body: {"answer": "Coach Ilja (also referred to as Ilja Semjonovs or Coach Ilya) is a high-level tennis coach from Lafayette who has been described as a total package coach. He is connected to the GreatBase Tennis program and has been a dedicated contributor to it for years. He put together a training program that attracted over 450 signups, including coaches and adult players. He is also the head coach for the Latvian tennis team and has worked with notable players, including making a film for Leila Fernandez's sister Bianca. He was known for his energy, confidence, and commanding presence, and was greatly respected by those around him.
